chapter_title: Multimedia Storyboarding and AI Asset Generation
title: Prompt Logs as Design Evidence
description: AIL 606 textbook section on curating prompt logs as design evidence: turning a raw AI chat transcript into a curated argument for the final asset, with intent, outcome, and disposition per entry, preserved rejections with reasons, and a verification step.

learning_objectives.statement: Curate a raw AI chat history into a prompt log that argues for the final asset, with each kept entry carrying intent, outcome, and disposition
Distinguish a passive transcript from a curated design log that explains failures, not just successes
Preserve at least one informative rejection, with its reason, tied to the learning function the asset must serve
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
